title: LeBron James Los Angeles Lakers smALL-STARS Minis 6" Vinyl Figurine Purple/Gold

descriptionText:
Show your love for the Los Angeles Lakers and LeBron James with this officially licensed smALL-STARS minis vinyl figurine. Standing at 6 inches tall, this unisex adult collectible features the iconic purple and gold colors of the team and comes in the shape of Small Stars product. Perfect for any basketball or NBA fan, this figurine is a must-have for those who want to add a touch of Lakers pride to their collection.

The LeBron James Los Angeles Lakers smALL-STARS Minis 6" Vinyl Figurine is made in the United States and is perfect for regular season fans. Its small size makes it easy to display in any home or office space. Buy it now and show off your love for the Lakers in a unique and stylish way!
